step.goal: Web research for latest technical specifics

workflow.step:
🌐 ENSURE LATEST TECH KNOWLEDGE - Prevent outdated implementations!
**WEB INTELLIGENCE:** Identify specific technical areas that require latest version knowledge:
From architecture analysis, identify specific libraries, APIs, or frameworks For each critical technology, research latest stable version and key changes: - Latest API documentation and breaking changes - Security vulnerabilities or updates - Performance improvements or deprecations - Best practices for current version
**EXTERNAL CONTEXT INCLUSION:** Include in story any critical latest information the developer needs: - Specific library versions and why chosen - API endpoints with parameters and authentication - Recent security patches or considerations - Performance optimization techniques - Migration considerations if upgrading

📝 CREATE ULTIMATE STORY DOCUMENT - The developer's master guide! 🎯 TASK FORMAT: Use "### Task N: Title" with "- [ ]" checkbox subtasks - NOT tables!
Generate story document with the following structure:
**# {{title derived from feature_description}}**
**Created:** {{current date in YYYY-MM-DD format}}
---
**## Story**
Generate a proper user story statement: Create story statement in format: As a {{role - identify the user type from context}}, I want {{action - the core capability being requested}}, so that {{benefit - the value this provides}}.
**## Acceptance Criteria**
Generate acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then format: **Given** [precondition] **When** [action] **Then** [expected result]
Include 3-6 acceptance criteria covering main scenarios and edge cases
**## Tasks / Subtasks**
🚨 CRITICAL FORMAT - Use this exact structure:
### Task 1: [Task Title] - [ ] Subtask description with specific file path or action - [ ] Another subtask with concrete deliverable - [ ] Additional subtask as needed
### Task 2: [Next Task Title] - [ ] Subtask description - [ ] Another subtask
Break down implementation into 3-8 logical tasks Each task should have 2-5 specific, actionable subtasks Subtasks must include file paths where applicable Order tasks by dependency (what must be done first) DO NOT use tables for tasks - use the ### Task N format with checkbox subtasks
---
**## Relevant Feature Documentation**
Include any relevant patterns, examples, or documentation discovered during analysis If no relevant docs found, state: "_No relevant documentation matched for this feature._"
---
**## Developer Context**
**### Technical Requirements** - From {{developer_guardrails}}: stack, patterns, constraints
**### Architecture Compliance** - Required patterns and conventions from codebase analysis - Integration points and dependencies
**### Library & Framework Requirements** - Specific versions, APIs, and usage patterns
**### File Structure Requirements** - Where files should be created/modified - Naming conventions to follow
**### Testing Requirements** - Testing standards and frameworks - Coverage expectations
---
**## Previous Story Intelligence**
Include insights from codebase patterns and similar implementations If first story or no relevant previous work: "_This is a new feature area._"
---
**## Git Intelligence**
- From {{git_intelligence}}: recent relevant changes and patterns
---
**## Latest Technical Information**
- From web research: library versions, API updates, best practices
---
**## Dev Notes**
**### Key Implementation Decisions** - Critical architectural choices for this feature - Trade-offs considered
**### Project Structure Notes** - Alignment with existing project structure - Any detected conflicts or considerations
**### References** - Cite all technical details with source paths, e.g. [Source: path/to/file.md#Section]
---
**## Dev Agent Record**
**### Context Reference** - Story file path (to be filled by dev agent)
**### Agent Model Used** - (To be filled by dev agent upon implementation)
**### Debug Log References** - N/A (populated during implementation)
**### Completion Notes List** - (To be filled upon story completion)
**### File List** - **Created:** (list files created) - **Modified:** (list files modified)
Compile all sections into {{story_document}}
